title: PQ101-PQ110 canonical-first reward reconciliation and relationship metadata parity
source_of_truth: docs/data/pq-reward-relationships.json forward relationship array plus canonical Parallel Quest record layer; verified/index/reverse projections are consumers only.
findings: PQ101-PQ110 expected typed reward coverage is already represented in the canonical forward relationship layer; no duplicate reward edges were added.
PQ101: Champa's Clothes + Breaker Energy Wave are represented.
PQ102: Battle Suit (Cabba) + both documented Super Souls are represented.
PQ103: all three documented Super Souls are represented.
PQ104: Android 14's Clothes, Android 14's Hat, both skills, and the documented Super Soul are represented; the Hat is retained as a canonical accessory relationship rather than a clothing identity.
PQ105: Android 13's Clothes, Android 13's Hat, three skills, and both documented Super Souls are represented.
PQ106: Super Android 13's Clothes, three skills, and three documented Super Souls are represented.

PQ107: Future Mai's Clothes and You can't win... are represented. Future Mai's Hat remains outside the promoted equipment relationship layer because current evidence does not provide a canonical inventory endpoint; no identity was manufactured.
PQ108: Goku Black's Clothes and both documented Super Souls are represented.
PQ109: Zamasu's Clothes, Super Black Kamehameha Rosé, and both documented Super Souls are represented.

PQ110: Super Saiyan 4 Suit (Goku), SS4 Wig & Tail (Goku), Divinity Unleashed, and both documented Super Souls are represented. Zamasu's Clothes remains an explicit canonical equipment acquisition-source relationship for PQ110 even though it is not listed in the maintained basic-reward transcription; this is preserved as an acquisition-source edge, not asserted as a basic reward.
The canonical forward relationship array contains 880 unique relationship keys: 249 skill, 142 Super Soul, 147 equipment, 247 character, 88 DLC, and 7 farming.
The persisted current_counts metadata in pq-reward-relationships.json was stale at 877 and has been reconciled to the live 880-edge array.
The reverse projection already matches the 880-edge forward graph, with 249/142/147/247/88/7 relationship-edge counts and 244/140/142/75/21/1 unique reverse targets.

The Super Soul cross-link projection is current at 177 canonical Super Soul records, 142 PQ Super Soul edges, 140 unique targets, 142 detailed endpoint matches, 142 acquisition-index matches, and zero unresolved endpoint names.
No runtime/CI success claim is made.
boundaries: Do not treat sparse normalized-map omissions as negative evidence.
Do not infer exact drop rates or Ultimate Finish gating from acquisition-source links alone.
Do not promote Future Mai's Hat without an exact canonical accessory endpoint.
Do not use verified:true layers as the source of truth.
next_frontier: PQ111-PQ120 canonical-first reward reconciliation, with special attention to accessory/equipment endpoint identity and any projection metadata drift.
